description: This PHP source file defines a view class 'CalendarAccountViewDetail' inheriting from 'ViewDetail' for the SuiteCRM project. It customizes the pre-display behavior by ensuring calendar source types are loaded and indicating admin status to the front end.

classes.name: CalendarAccountViewDetail
classes.description: A view class for displaying calendar account details, extending the base 'ViewDetail' class, with custom pre-display logic.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to load calendar source types if not already loaded and outputs admin status to JavaScript.
